en: Revenue rose 26% to $64.6B, beating ~$63.3B, as ad impressions grew 10% and price per ad 14%. GAAP EPS of $3.83 absorbed a $9.89B charge for the youth-safety deal with 52 attorneys general; excluding it, EPS was $7.40 and operating margin 35.4%. Capex of $34.9B outran operating cash flow, so free cash flow was −$2.1B and there were no buybacks. The Q4 guide of $73–76B tops consensus, 2026 capex was narrowed to $135–145B, and CFO Susan Li expects strong growth through 2027, with Reality Labs losses narrowing to ~$15B. Zuckerberg said Muse passed 10M users in six weeks; a non-voting Class C share is planned for January.

Shares first rose about 3.8% after hours, then closed down 7.0% at $648.85 in the first session as negative free cash flow, over $800B of commitments and the non-voting Class C plan revived funding worries. The slide continued: on Oct 26 Meta priced a $25B share sale at $625, with $12.5B of convertible preferred and a planned $60B at-the-market program, and the stock fell to $612.49 by Oct 28 before closing at $624.52 on Oct 29, 10.5% below its pre-report close.
zh: 营收增长 26% 至 646 亿美元，高于约 633 亿的预期，广告展示量增 10%、单价增 14%。GAAP 每股收益 3.83 美元，计入与 52 位州总检察长达成青少年安全和解的 98.9 亿美元费用；剔除后每股 7.40 美元，营业利润率 35.4%。资本开支 349 亿美元超过经营现金流，自由现金流为 −21 亿美元，当季未回购。第四季营收指引 730–760 亿美元高于预期，2026 年资本开支区间收窄至 1,350–1,450 亿美元；CFO Susan Li 预计 2027 年全年保持强劲增长，Reality Labs 亏损收窄至约 150 亿。扎克伯格称 Muse 六周内用户突破 1000 万；公司计划于明年 1 月推出无投票权 C 类股。

盘后股价一度上涨约 3.8%，首个交易日却收跌 7.0% 至 648.85 美元：自由现金流为负、逾 8,000 亿美元的承诺以及无投票权 C 类股计划重新引发融资担忧。跌势随后延续：10 月 26 日 Meta 以每股 625 美元定价 250 亿美元增发，另有 125 亿美元强制可转换优先股及计划中的 600 亿美元按市价发行计划；股价至 10 月 28 日跌至 612.49 美元，10 月 29 日收于 624.52 美元，较财报前收盘低 10.5%。

bio.en: Founded Facebook at Harvard in 2004 and has run it ever since; renamed it Meta in 2021. Controls the majority of votes through Class B shares, and is now betting on AI superintelligence, giant data centers and the Muse AI agent.
bio.zh: 2004 年在哈佛创办 Facebook 并一直执掌，2021 年更名为 Meta。通过 B 类股掌握多数投票权，目前押注 AI 超级智能、超大型数据中心和 Muse AI 智能体。

bio.en: CFO since November 2022. Joined Facebook's finance team in 2008, before the IPO, and spent years leading business finance and planning. Manages the 2026 capex guidance of $135–145B and the new Class C share plan.
bio.zh: 2022 年 11 月起任 CFO。2008 年加入 Facebook 财务团队（早于上市），多年负责业务财务与规划。主管 2026 年 1,350–1,450 亿美元的资本开支指引及新 C 类股计划。
